signatureAction.description: What happens to a pod whose images aren't signed by the golden path: Deny (default) or Audit (allowed, reported in PolicyReports). Use Audit while moving existing apps onto the golden path.

signerRefRegExp.description: Git refs of the platform repository's build-app.yml whose signatures are trusted, as a regular expression. Default: main and release tags (refs/heads/main, refs/tags/v<major>...).

allowedImages.description: Exact image references (with tag or digest) that app namespaces may also run, e.g. a pinned curl image used by canary analysis. Not signature-checked: keep the list short.
